description: This file defines the ForecastQueryServiceClient class, a client for interacting with the Amazon Forecast Query Service using AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method signatures for querying forecasts and asynchronous operations.

classes.name: ForecastQueryServiceClient
classes.description: Client class for Amazon Forecast Query Service, extending AwsClient to provide specific API methods for forecast querying.

methods.name: queryForecast
methods.description: Method to synchronously query forecast data using provided arguments.

methods.name: queryForecastAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously query forecast data, returning a promise.

methods.name: queryWhatIfForecast
methods.description: Method to synchronously query 'what-if' forecast data.

methods.name: queryWhatIfForecastAsync
methods.description: Method to asynchronously query 'what-if' forecast data, returning a promise.
